asks: Asks that any new Calgary seat go to south Calgary, that hybrid ridings be continued and expanded around Calgary, and that population parity be applied flexibly.
Asks that Heritage Hills stay in Strathcona-Sherwood Park and that Beaumont and parts of Leduc County not be added to it.
Asks the commission to abandon attaching Beaumont to Strathcona-Sherwood Park and removing Heritage Hills, keeping the riding's boundaries stable.
Asks that Calgary-North West include Bearspaw, Church Ranches, Watermark and Glenbow.
Asks the commission to adopt option ED 24B for the Okotoks riding rather than the Calgary-Okotoks hybrid ED 24.
Supports the proposed changes moving Radisson Heights-Albert Park to Confluence and Tuxedo into Calgary-Klein.
Red Deer County objects to the removal of Rimbey-Rocky Mountain House-Sundre and asks that the county continue to be represented by two rural electoral divisions.

quote: The removal of the Rimbey - Rocky Mountain House - Sundre electoral division dilutes the voice of our agricultural community
note: Rule 4: objection to dissolving the riding read as a want to keep it. Primary ask is that Red Deer County be represented by two rural divisions; does not discuss Clearwater County's division explicitly.

asks: Asks that Lake Bonavista/Bonaventure stay in Calgary-Fish Creek, that existing south Calgary boundaries be left as they are, and that a new constituency be created in the south-end growth area.
Supports the interim changes to Edmonton-West Henday.
Asks that any new Calgary seat go to the south, supports hybrid ridings such as Tsuut'ina in Calgary West, and asks for full use of the 25% variance.
Asks that Tofield be moved from Camrose into Strathcona-Sherwood Park instead of adding Beaumont there.
Asks that Stony Plain and Spruce Grove stay together, questions the Beaumont options, asks that Sherwood Park extend to Highway 21, and asks for a more usable report.
Asks for more seats in Edmonton and Calgary and raises concern about combining rural and urban communities.
Asks for a third additional seat inside Calgary and for hybrid ridings to be rejected entirely.
Asks that the commission's recommendations be accepted without alteration and that its independence be protected.
Asks that Beaumont not be added to Strathcona-Sherwood Park.
Asks that Jasper stay in West Yellowhead rather than join Banff in a national-parks riding.
Cautiously supports the interim map, asks for at least one more Edmonton seat, and asks that no further hybrid ridings be created.
Asks for an electoral district joining parts of the City of Lethbridge with the Crowsnest Pass, Waterton Lakes National Park and southern communities such as Raymond, Magrath and Cardston.

quote: I am writing a proposal for an electoral district that includes parts of the City of Lethbridge, the Crowsnest Pass, Waterton Lakes National Park, and the surrounding southern Alberta communities.
note: Asks for one district joining part of the city to Crowsnest Pass, Waterton, Raymond, Magrath, Cardston; says nothing about the rest of the city or a four-way design, so L3 rather than L2. Resembles parts of the minority's Lethbridge-Fort Macleod-Crowsnest Pass and Lethbridge-Cardston but combines them. Form header names Lethbridge-West.

asks: A Calgary Ward 9 councillor asks that no other municipality or bedroom community be joined to a provincial riding overlapping Ward 9 and supports the interim map's approach for Calgary.
Supports the interim report's St. Albert riding boundaries and asks that the current ridings be left as much as possible as they are.

quote: I believe the current interim report reflects the wishes of St. Albert residents and identifies effective representation for St. Albert voters.
note: Supports the interim St. Albert riding with its slight adjustment; also 'There is strong support to leave the current ridings as much as possible as is.' Says nothing about Sturgeon County or Lac Ste. Anne-Parkland, so S0.

asks: Asks that Lesser Slave Lake be retained as an intact electoral district rather than dissolved into adjacent northern ridings.

quote: I am writing to respectfully urge the Commission to retain the electoral district of Lesser Slave Lake in its current, intact form, rather than dissolving it into adjacent Northern ridings.

asks: Asks that Heritage Hills stay in Strathcona-Sherwood Park and Beaumont not be added; suggests Tofield if more population is needed.
Supports the interim changes to Edmonton-Strathcona, including adding the university campus.
Asks that Blackfalds be placed in the new Innisfail riding with Innisfail, Delburne and Bowden.
Supports the interim report, asks that neighbourhood boundaries be preserved, and opposes hybrid urban-rural ridings.
The Town of Bentley welcomes its place in Lacombe-Rocky Mountain House but supports Rocky Mountain House's wish to be in a division with all of Clearwater County and Sundre.

quote: my council is providing full support to their wish to be included in an electoral division, with all of Clearwater County and Sundre due to their extensive relationships to the communities within it.
note: Also: 'we feel that they would be best represented through an electoral division, that includes similar western communities of interest, like Clearwater County and Sundre.' Bentley itself is content in Lacombe-Rocky Mountain House; questions why RMH was included, no explicit rejection of W3 beyond that.

quote: we feel that they would be best represented through an electoral division, that includes similar western communities of interest, like Clearwater County and Sundre.
note: Codebook section 4: 'Sundre belongs with Rocky Mountain House' maps to O1 here. The letter never names Olds or the Mountain View riding; inferred only from Sundre being placed with RMH.

asks: A Sturgeon County resident supports the interim report's few changes to Morinville-St. Albert and its renaming to St. Albert-Sturgeon.

quote: I am very glad to see in the interim report there are very few changes to the boundaries to Morinville- St albert and changes purposed do make geographical sense.
note: Supports the interim hybrid St. Albert-Sturgeon as drawn; nothing on Lac Ste. Anne-Parkland or uniting Sturgeon County, so S0.

asks: Asks that Edmonton-Riverview and Edmonton-Glenora not be combined and that core Edmonton ridings be restored closer to the old map while keeping the south-side changes.
Asks that the City of Beaumont not be divided along 50 Street and be kept whole in Leduc-Beaumont.
Asks that Beaumont not be attached to Strathcona-Sherwood Park and Heritage Hills not be removed; suggests Tofield if population must be added.

The MLA for Grande Prairie-Wapiti asks that Lesser Slave Lake be kept and expanded, proposes a northern map based on the 2017 boundaries with two 15(2) districts, supports more hybrid ridings, and asks that Sexsmith be included in Grande Prairie-Wapiti.

quote: The interim report’s proposed boundaries were rejected because removing the Lesser Slave Lake electoral district resulted in a variety of problems to effective representation in the north.
note: Proposes LSL expanded with the rest of Big Lakes County, MD of Lesser Slave River, Swan Hills and Fort Assiniboine area (p. 71-72), close to the minority's LSL. Also p. 69: 'A key aspect is maintaining the existence of the Lesser Slave Lake electoral district'.
St. Albert named only as an example of capital-region communities sharing lived experience, in an argument for more hybrids (rule 6).

asks: Asks the commission to account for fast growth in mature urban neighbourhoods and suggests another Edmonton riding may be fair.
Asks for an additional riding within the City of Edmonton and objects to combining Edmonton-Riverview and Edmonton-Glenora.
Agrees with opposition to removing Jasper from West Yellowhead.
Asks for a hybrid rural-urban model for Lethbridge, with adjacent communities and county areas included in the Lethbridge ridings rather than two urban-only divisions.

quote: I respectfully ask the Commission to consider a hybrid rural-urban model for the Lethbridge region by adjusting the Lethbridge ridings so that some immediately adjacent, strongly connected communities and county areas are included with Lethbridge
note: Rejection quote (p. 88): 'I'm concerned the interim structure keeps Lethbridge as two mostly urban-only ridings while placing closely connected nearby communities into a separate, very large rural division.' Asks for hybrids as a design without the four-way particulars; 'some immediately adjacent' communities could also be read as L3.

asks: The Edson and District Chamber of Commerce asks that Jasper not be taken out of West Yellowhead.
Broadly supports the Edmonton-Beverly-Clareview map, asks that hybrid ridings be reduced, and asks that central Edmonton not lose a riding.
Thanks the commission for keeping Edmonton and Calgary intact with minimal hybrids and asks that Edmonton get another seat and not lose its downtown riding.
Supports the interim changes to Calgary-Klein and its trades with Calgary-Confluence and Calgary-Mountain View.
Asks that urban areas not be split up with rural areas, since urban and rural needs differ.

note: Form header: municipality Lethbridge, current and proposed Lethbridge-West. Message says 'Splitting up urban dilutes this for good representation' and that all cities should use a ward system; a general anti-hybrid stance that could be read as L1 via the header (rule 2), but it names no arrangement for Lethbridge, so coded narrowly (rule 17).

asks: Asks that Heritage Hills stay in Sherwood Park and that Strathcona County not be joined with Beaumont.

The MLA for Fort McMurray-Lac La Biche submits the joint northern proposal: keep and expand Lesser Slave Lake, base northern ridings on the 2017 map with two 15(2) districts, adjust the Fort McMurray ridings, and create more hybrid ridings.

quote: The interim report’s proposed boundaries were rejected because removing the Lesser Slave Lake electoral district resulted in a variety of problems to effective representation in the north.
note: campaign EBC-2025-2-0978 (same joint northern proposal, text repeated twice in this record, pp. 104-115 and 126-134). Proposes LSL expanded with the rest of Big Lakes County, MD of Lesser Slave River, Swan Hills and Fort Assiniboine area.
St. Albert named only as an example of capital-region communities in the argument for more hybrids (rule 6).

asks: The MLA for Calgary-North West asks that Bearspaw and Watermark be added to Calgary-North West and that Springbank be included in Calgary-Bow.
